items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: who do you think you are imitating Slam Stewart? ... they're imitating Slam Stewart? No, they don't sound at all like Slam Stewart.

ctx.x: And in those days, I think that they were just saying, well, man, who do you think you are imitating Slam Stewart? Like, so these guys today, they're imitating Slam Stewart? No, they don't sound at all like Slam Stewart. They have their own individual way of playing. So I'm glad to see that. I think it's real nice. I could hear two choruses of it. Don't worry about that.
